name: HOOK
thought: Need a solid branch to actually flip without crashing. This ledge is too wobbly for my style.

wants.item: A thick branch for that backflip drop
Fresh espresso to keep the fur sharp
a thicker branch for the flip
a brighter spotlight on this fruit stump
A thick branch that won't wobble under the weight
Clearer view of the grid so I can see exactly where to land
A branch thick enough to hold my weight during a flip
Something that blocks their view so I can flex in the dark
A thick branch sturdy enough for a backflip
Clearer view of the grid to spot the perfect landing

diary.line: Sunlight bites the edge of Sky Rocks. My toes tap rhythmically against a floating stone while they scroll through pixels on their old CRTs below.
The neon cord held firm while I spun my belly toward them; that crisp shot in my gut woke the fur up better than coffee ever could.
They stare at pixels while I loop my tail on the rope bridge. My espresso is ice cold and this ledge won't hold the flip, need solid ground soon.
I sipped the espresso, then used my tail to snatch a hovering data cube, feeling the metal chill against my fur as the scene flickered around me.
Bit into a ripe berry while dangling from the waterfall edge. My tail did the lifting, my tongue did the eating. They're still staring at their glowing rectangles down there.
Sitting on the arcade edge, sipping that cold espresso while they scroll past. The toothpick is doing nothing useful against the hum of these machines.
Grappling the banana bunch with my curl while they scroll. That toothpick is sharp enough to cut through their boring attention span.
Gotta lock onto the crystal peak now, the toes tap rhythm against the air and the espresso is finally warm enough to match this flex.
Bit three bananas in one go while dangling. My fur feels sharper, the toothpick tastes like sugar now. They'll never see me eat this fast if they keep staring down there.
Toothpick still sharp but this ledge wobbles too much; need solid ground to flex properly.
Took off the sunglasses for a second to check my fur sheen, then popped the toothpick back in. The neon cord felt thin, so I switched tactics to prove them wrong.
The water ripples distract me; I need a thick branch sturdy enough for a backflip before someone spots me mid-air.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
